verdict.line: You lose if you trade near walls or get hit by Test of Spirit before level 6; you win if you reach level 6-9 even, because Trinity Force and Relentless Assault flip every extended duel after that.

brief.thesis: Illaoi's lane power comes from Tentacles spawning on nearby terrain (her passive, boosted by Q) and the spirit-echo burst of E, both of which punish standing and fighting near walls before Jax has his ultimate online. Once Jax hits level 6 and gets Relentless Assault, and once Trinity Force comes online, the matchup flips: Illaoi has no tool to dodge Jax's Counter Strike stun, and her own ultimate sits on a 120-second cooldown at rank 1, so she can't force a second all-in if the first one fails.

theirWindow.when: She lands Test of Spirit near a wall
theirWindow.what: Once Test of Spirit is on you, any damage Illaoi deals to the spirit echoes back to you, and if the spirit dies or you get too far from it you become a Vessel that spawns its own Tentacles. Walk out of her Q/W/auto range immediately rather than trading through it.

yourWindow.when: Her W and E are both down
yourWindow.what: With Harsh Lesson and Test of Spirit on cooldown, Illaoi has no burst or gap-close threat. Leap Strike in, Empower your hit, and start stacking Relentless Assault autos — this is your highest-value engage window.

start.why: Measured at 69.4% win rate over 36 games and the clear majority pick (66.7%) — the extra sustain and early damage matter in a lane where you're taking Tentacle and spirit-echo chip damage you can't always avoid.

boots.why: 84.6% pick and 63.6% win rate over 44 games — the flat damage reduction blunts her autos and Tentacle procs, which is what lets you stand in extended trades once your R is online.

core.why: The highest-performing measured path (75% win rate over 4 games); the stat stick gives you the attack speed, damage, and tenacity to out-duel her once lane stabilizes.
Follows Trinity Force in the strongest recorded build path — adds sustain to your empowered hits, letting you win prolonged skirmishes near her Tentacle terrain instead of just her open-field fights.
Caps the core path at 75% win rate; lets you survive the moment she commits Harsh Lesson into Test of Spirit so you can punish the follow-up with Counter Strike.

her burst from Harsh Lesson into Test of Spirit is what's actually killing you, not sustained damage

runes.keystoneWhy: The best-performing measured page (35.9% pick, 68.4% win rate) — the ramping attack speed stacks directly with Relentless Assault's own bonus, so your duels accelerate faster than Illaoi, who has no attack-speed answer, can keep up with.

summoners.why: The clear measured favorite at 75.5% pick and 65% win rate. Flash answers her Harsh Lesson engage or lets you disengage out of Test of Spirit range, while Ignite converts the trades you win after level 6 into actual kills before she can walk off with Tentacle healing.

playing.title: Counter Strike their autos, not their skills
playing.detail: Counter Strike dodges all incoming basic attacks, then stuns and damages everyone around you after a brief channel. Time it for when Illaoi commits to auto-attacking you in a trade — it denies her healing off landed hits and wins the exchange outright.

playing.title: Never trade near walls
playing.detail: Her passive spawns Tentacles on nearby impassible terrain that swing at you and heal her on hit, and Q increases their damage further. Pull fights toward open lane instead of jungle boundaries or river walls.

playing.title: Disengage the second Test of Spirit lands
playing.detail: If hit by E, any damage she deals to the forced-out spirit echoes back to you, and letting the spirit die or lagging too far behind turns you into a Vessel that spawns its own Tentacles. Walk out of her kit range rather than fighting through it.

playing.title: Hold Leap Strike for punishes, not pokes
playing.detail: Before level 6 you have no Relentless Assault to win an extended trade, so save Leap Strike to punish her when Harsh Lesson whiffs or she overextends, rather than using it to initiate.

playing.title: Time your first all-in to level 6
playing.detail: Relentless Assault has no cooldown once learned and gives bonus damage on every third consecutive hit — look for your first real all-in the moment you hit level 6, ideally while her Leap of Faith is still unavailable (120s base cooldown).

playing.title: Rush Trinity Force before forcing fights
playing.detail: The measured core (Trinity Force into Sundered Sky into Zhonya's Hourglass) is what actually flips this matchup; don't commit to extended duels until at least Trinity Force is up.

playing.title: Use Ignite to close out even trades
playing.detail: Illaoi heals off landed Tentacle and auto damage, so even trades you'd normally win can slip away. Ignite removes that healing window and turns a close fight into a confirmed kill.

brief.patchCaveat: Build, runes, and summoners are pulled directly from measured Jax-vs-Illaoi games on the current patch (16.20.1); the trade timing, tentacle/wall, and Test of Spirit warnings are my own tactical read of the kit, not scraped stats.
